title: How to make money with AI in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: By 2026, AI monetization hinges on protocol-driven frameworks, not just tools. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're wrong—without a clear "to," even the best "how" fails. Real money comes from solving real problems. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Protocols like MLOps and AutoML scale AI deployment—cutting costs by 40% in enterprise use cases. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without a defined "to," you waste resources. AI must target verticals—healthcare, fintech, logistics—specifically. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future belongs to those who know exactly where they're going. (4 sec)
